items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I played with him. Yeah, I was with him.

ctx.x: I don't know the trumpet players or something like that. I can recall the old man who was a bass player. the bass player, Johnny Prodoss and George Stude. And Albert Walters said he played with them, trumpet player Albert Fernandez and he'll play with us now. He said he worked with them.
Do you remember Wooden Joe Nicholas? Oh yeah, I remember Wooden Joe. Did he play with the Camellia Band?
Yeah, that's right. He was a trumpet player, played with the Camellia Band. I thought he was with him. That's right. When you were with him? I played with him. Yeah, I was with him.
